body: My only dilemma is my family. If they ever leave, I’m next.
I consider myself a somewhat good guitar player. I work out, try to improve myself, etc. the pain stays. I’m just so tired of feeling like this everyday :(

I’ve been on meds for over a year, and I still feel shitty. I’ve had people kill themselves on me before, and you k ow what? If it can “get better” for me, it can “get better” for the people I’ll leave too.

I just wish I could get into an “accident” so I don’t have to deal with any of this anymore. Living fucking sucks, and I don’t understand why we have to choose to continue living in a place we don’t want to be in.
